content.text:
**Summary:**

I investigated ticket T-4008 about broken legacy portal redirects after an ingress-nginx upgrade to v1.12.1. The cluster shows:
- Legacy-portal pods are running and healthy in the legacy namespace
- Ingress controller (v1.12.1) is running in the ingress-nginx namespace
- The Ingress resource has not changed

The root cause appears to be that ingress-nginx v1.12.1 made breaking changes to redirect handling, removing support for regex capture groups in redirect annotations. The ticket notes that standard redirect annotations cannot express the regex patterns they need. Since this requires either rolling back the controller version, implementing custom nginx configuration, or redesigning the redirect logic—all of which need hands-on testing and review—I escalated the ticket to the platform team for proper resolution.
